full_judgment: 4. The opposite parties Kazi Abdul Mannan and others as plaintiff's filed Title Suit No. 22 of 2001 against Kazi Harun Mia in the Court of Joint District Judge, 1st Court, Comilla for partition of the suit land and the plaintiffs case, in short, is that Ashraf Uddin Kazi and Arfan Bibi by a registered Patta of 1314 BS got settlement of the land and by amicable partition Ashraf Uddin Kazi got 34 decimals land and Arfan Bibi got rest 25 decimals land. After the death of Ashraf Uddin Kazi his brother Bosiruddin Kazi inherited his properties and Arfan Bibi sold 25 decimals land to Bosiruddin Kazi by an unregistered deed of 1317 BS at a price of Taka 40 and as a result Bosiruddin Kazi became owner of the said land. Bosiruddin Kazi died leaving behind the said Kazi Abdul Mannan and two daughters and by amicable partition Bosiruddin Kazi got aforesaid 46.5 decimals land and he made a Waqf in favour of Mosque of an area of 30 decimals land by a deed dated 2-9-1952 and thereafter he exchanged the said land with the Mosque Committee by a Exchange deed No.4593 dated 20-11-1981 and filed the instant suit praying for decree of partition impleading Kazi Harun Mia as defendant No.1.
